cases.title: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respect
cases.question:
List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Exclusively virtual refers to Virtual = 'F'; respective counties means PARTITION BY County

cases.title: Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the count
cases.question:
Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17) can be acquired by `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100

cases.title: What is the postal street address for the school with the 7th highest Math
cases.question:
What is the postal street address for the school with the 7th highest Math average? Indicate the school's name.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Postal street and mailing street are synonyms.

cases.title: What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci U
cases.question:
What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci Ulrich? List the schools and the corresponding average writing scores.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Usually, administrators manage the school stuff.

cases.title: Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT i
cases.question:
Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT is grater than 400, what is the funding type of these schools?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Average of average math = sum(average math scores) / count(schools).

cases.title: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grade
cases.question:
Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: State Special Schools refers to DOC = 31; Grades 1 through 12 means K-12

cases.title: What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange Count
cases.question:
What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange County to merged Elementary School District schools?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Elementary School District refers to DOC = 52; Unified School District refers to DOC = 54.

cases.question:
Between San Diego and Santa Barbara, which county offers the most number of schools that does not offer physical building? Indicate the amount.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: 'Does not offer physical building' means Virtual = F in the database.

cases.title: Under whose administration is the school with the highest number of student
cases.question:
Under whose administration is the school with the highest number of students scoring 1500 or more on the SAT? Indicate their full names.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: full name means first name, last name; There are at most 3 administrators for each school; SAT Scores are greater or equal to 1500 refers to NumGE1500

cases.title: What is the eligible free or reduced price meal rate for the top 5 schools
cases.question:
What is the eligible free or reduced price meal rate for the top 5 schools in grades 1-12 with the highest free or reduced price meal count of the schools with the ownership code 66?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: grades 1-12 means K-12; Eligible free or reduced price meal rate for K-12 = `FRPM Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`

cases.title: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the high
cases.question:
Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Excellence rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`

cases.title: What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by
cases.question:
What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` * 100%

cases.title: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT
cases.question:

Benchmark knowledge evidence: Exclusively virtual refers to Virtual = 'F'

cases.title: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater t
cases.question:

cases.title: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County
cases.question:
What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Elementary School District refers to DOC = 52; Monthly average number of schools that opened in 1980 = count(schools that opened in 1980) / 12

cases.title: What is the total number of non-chartered schools in the county of Los Ange
cases.question:
What is the total number of non-chartered schools in the county of Los Angeles with a percent (%) of eligible free meals for grades 1 through 12 that is less than 0.18%?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: non-chartered schools refer to schools whose Charter = 0; K-12 means grades 1 through 12; percent of eligible free rate for K-12 = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / `Enrollment (K-12)`
